Close to the Hebrew; “In her house her feet do not stay” is rendered “Her feet do not remain at home.”

Close to the Hebrew; “Colored fabrics, linen of Egypt” is rendered “colored linens of Egypt.”

Close to the Hebrew; “She turns him” is rendered “she entices him,” and “she impels him” as “she seduces him.”
“Like an anklet to the chastening of a fool” is rendered “as one in fetters to the discipline of a fool.” The meaning of the Hebrew is uncertain.
